description: Page the reviews section of a proposal-linked candidate dossier (the same curated set the public profile exposes). Cursor-paged: pass nextCursor from the previous page; a non-null nextCursor means more pages exist, so nothing truncates silently. Emails, phone numbers, links, physical addresses and messaging handles in employer-authored comments are replaced server-side with explicit [REDACTED_*] placeholders, and redactions carries one PRIVACY_MASKED entry per category of each redacted comment on the page (field reviews[<index>].comment, never the removed value); a clean comment gets no entry. Requires candidate_dossier:read scope and the default-off candidate-dossier agent surface.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page (nextCursor). Omit for the first page.

proposalId.description: OpenTrain proposal (job offer) id the candidate dossier is linked to.

name: opentrain_list_candidate_dossier_reviews
